eol.janazah.5.arabic: وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِنْ دَارِهِ وَأَهْلاً خَيْرًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَزَوْجًا خَيْرًا مِنْ زَوْجِهِ

eol.janazah.6.arabic: وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ أَوْ مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ

eol.janazah.6.meaning: Admit him to Paradise, and protect him from the punishment of the grave or of the Fire.

eol.janazah.dua.translit: Allaahummagh-fir lahu warhamhu wa 'aafihi wa'-fu 'anhu. Wa akrim nuzulahu wa wassi' mudkhalahu. Waghsilhu bil-maa'i wath-thalji wal-barad. Wa naqqihi minal-khataayaa kamaa naqqaytath-thawbal-abyada minad-danas. Wa abdilhu daaran khayran min daarihi wa ahlan khayran min ahlihi wa zawjan khayran min zawjihi. Wa adkhilhul-jannah wa a'idh-hu min 'adhaabil-qabri aw min 'adhaabin-naar.
eol.janazah.dua.meaning: O Allah, forgive him, have mercy on him, grant him safety and pardon him. Honour his arrival and make his entrance wide. Wash him with water, snow and hail. Cleanse him of his wrongs as a white garment is cleansed of dirt. Give him in exchange a home better than his home, a family better than his family, and a spouse better than his spouse. Admit him to Paradise, and protect him from the punishment of the grave or of the Fire.

eol.general.1.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا
eol.general.1.translit: Allaahummagh-fir li-hayyinaa wa mayyitinaa wa saghirinaa wa kabirinaa wa dhakarinaa wa unthaanaa wa shaahidinaa wa ghaa'ibinaa

eol.general.2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الإِسْلاَمِ
eol.general.2.translit: Allaahumma man ahyaytahu minnaa fa-ahyihi 'alal-eemaan wa man tawaffaytahu minnaa fa-tawaffahu 'alal-islaam
eol.general.2.meaning: O Allah, whoever of us You keep alive, keep him alive in faith; and whoever of us You take, take him in Islam.

eol.general.3.meaning: O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward, and do not let us go astray after him.

Allaahumma man ahyaytahu minnaa fa-ahyihi 'alal-eemaan wa man tawaffaytahu minnaa fa-tawaffahu 'alal-islaam. Allaahumma laa tahrimnaa ajrahu wa laa tudillanaa ba'dah.

eol.grave.greeting.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَلَاحِقُونَ أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمْ الْعَافِيَةَ
eol.grave.greeting.translit: As-salaamu 'alaykum ahlad-diyaari minal-mu'mineena wal-muslimeen wa innaa in shaa'al-laahu lalaahiqoon as'alul-laaha lanaa wa lakumul-'aafiyah
eol.grave.greeting.meaning: Peace be upon you, people of this place, among the believers and the Muslims. If Allah wills, we will join you. I ask Allah for well-being for us and for you.

eol.grave.refuge.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
eol.grave.refuge.translit: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabi jahannam wa min 'adhaabil-qabr wa min fitnatil-mahyaa wal-mamaat wa min sharri fitnatil-maseehid-dajjaal
eol.grave.refuge.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the punishment of Hell, from the punishment of the grave, from the trial of life and death, and from the evil of the trial of the False Messiah (the Dajjal).

eol.eyes.1.meaning: O Allah, forgive Abu Salama, raise his rank among the guided, and take care of those he left behind.
